exercises.title: ICMP 1 — Messages and what they mean
exercises.problemHtml:
Read ICMP types and ping/traceroute output.

This set has 5 questions. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. The questions follow the style of the NWC204 final exam, so work them out on paper first, exactly as you would in the exam hall.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# ICMP 1 — Messages and what they mean — answer key

1. ICMP echo request (type 8) and echo reply (type 0) are used by …ICMP echo request (type 8) và echo reply (type 0) được dùng bởi …
   Answer: d) ping
   Ping tests reachability and round-trip time.VI: Ping kiểm tra khả năng tới được và thời gian khứ hồi.

2. A router discards a packet because its TTL reached 0. It sends …Router huỷ gói vì TTL về 0. Nó gửi …
   Answer: a) ICMP Time Exceeded (type 11)
   Traceroute exploits exactly this reply.VI: Traceroute khai thác đúng phản hồi này.

3. “Destination host unreachable” from your own gateway usually means …“Destination host unreachable” từ chính gateway thường nghĩa là …
   Answer: b) the router has no route or cannot ARP the host
   Destination Unreachable (type 3) comes from the router that cannot deliver.VI: Destination Unreachable (type 3) do router không chuyển được gửi về.

4. “Request timed out” in ping means …“Request timed out” trong ping nghĩa là …
   Answer: c) no reply came within the timeout (down, filtered, or lost)
   A firewall that drops ICMP looks the same as a dead host.VI: Firewall chặn ICMP trông giống host chết.

5. Each traceroute probe uses a TTL that is …Mỗi gói dò của traceroute dùng TTL …
   Answer: d) increased by one each time, starting at 1
   TTL 1 reaches hop 1, TTL 2 hop 2 and so on.VI: TTL 1 tới chặng 1, TTL 2 tới chặng 2…

exercises.title: ICMP 3 — Write traceroute(path, silent, maxTtl)
exercises.problemHtml:
Simulate traceroute. path lists the hop addresses (the last one is the destination), silent is an array of hop indexes (0-based) that never reply, maxTtl the highest TTL tried. Return one line per TTL as "<ttl> <address or *>", stopping right after the destination answers. If the path is shorter than a TTL (because the destination was silent or unreachable) print "<ttl> *" until maxTtl.

Requirements

  • Return the value; do not print it.
  • Do not modify the arguments.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Mô phỏng traceroute. path liệt kê địa chỉ các chặng (cuối cùng là đích), silent là mảng chỉ số chặng (từ 0) không bao giờ trả lời, maxTtl là TTL cao nhất thử. Trả mỗi TTL một dòng "<ttl> <địa chỉ hoặc *>", dừng ngay sau khi đích trả lời. Nếu đường ngắn hơn TTL (vì đích im lặng hoặc không tới được) in "<ttl> *" cho tới maxTtl.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả về giá trị, đừng in ra.
  • Không sửa các đối số.

hintsJson: Loop ttl from 1 to maxTtl; the router at index ttl − 1 answers.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
A silent last hop makes traceroute run to maxTtl, which is why firewalls produce lines of asterisks.

VI: Chặng cuối im lặng khiến traceroute chạy tới maxTtl, vì thế firewall cho ra cả dòng dấu sao.
